```{r}
cross_root <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("CROSS_WGBS_ROOT_DIR"),mustWork=TRUE)
cross_path <- function(value) normalizePath(if(grepl("^/",value)) value else file.path(cross_root,value),mustWork=FALSE)
integration_root <- normalizePath(cross_path("../../.."),mustWork=TRUE)
integration_config <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path(integration_root,"config/project.yml"))
pair <- basename(cross_root)
if(!pair %in% unlist(integration_config$cross_wgbs_pairs)) stop("未在cross_wgbs_pairs声明分支: ",pair)
contexts <- strsplit(pair,"_",fixed=TRUE)[[1L]]
if(length(contexts)!=2L) stop("pair名称须由两个context组成")
resolve_item <- function(context) {
  hit <- Filter(function(x)identical(x$id,paste0("wgbs_",context)),integration_config$inputs)
  if(length(hit)!=1L) stop("WGBS输入ID必须唯一: ",context)
  hit[[1L]]
}
items <- lapply(contexts,resolve_item)
joint_abs <- function(value) normalizePath(if(grepl("^/",value)) value else file.path(integration_root,value),mustWork=TRUE)
track_groups <- unlist(lapply(seq_along(items),function(i)lapply(c(integration_config$reference,integration_config$comparison),function(group)list(label=paste(group,contexts[i]),group=group,files=vapply(items[[i]]$tracks[[group]],joint_abs,character(1))))),recursive=FALSE)
cross_config <- list(
  source1_name=contexts[1L],source2_name=contexts[2L],source1_short=contexts[1L],source2_short=contexts[2L],
  source1_generation=if(is.null(items[[1L]]$generation)) "unknown" else as.character(items[[1L]]$generation),source2_generation=if(is.null(items[[2L]]$generation)) "unknown" else as.character(items[[2L]]$generation),
  source1_dmr_file=joint_abs(items[[1L]]$path),source2_dmr_file=joint_abs(items[[2L]]$path),
  gtf_file=joint_abs(integration_config$joint_inputs$gtf),txdb_file=joint_abs(integration_config$joint_inputs$txdb),cgi_file=joint_abs(integration_config$joint_inputs$cgi),
  expected_reference_group=integration_config$reference,expected_comparison_group=integration_config$comparison,
  min_abs_effect=.10,enforce_effect_contract=TRUE,comparable_ratio_lower=.75,comparable_ratio_upper=1.25,
  track_groups=track_groups,out_dir=file.path(Sys.getenv("FROZEN_RESULT_DIR"),"00_audit/cross_render",pair)
)

simplify_feature <- function(x) {
  x <- stringr::str_replace(as.character(x), " \\(.*", "")
  case_when(
    is.na(x) | x == "" ~ "Other",
    grepl("^Promoter|^Upstream$", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Promoter",
    grepl("UTR", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "UTR",
    grepl("Exon", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Exon",
    grepl("Intron", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Intron",
    grepl("Downstream", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Downstream",
    grepl("Distal Intergenic|Intergenic|^Distal$", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Intergenic",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

safe_label <- function(symbol_vec, gene_vec, prefix = "DMR") {
  raw_label <- dplyr::coalesce(symbol_vec, gene_vec, paste0(prefix, "_", seq_along(symbol_vec)))
  make.unique(as.character(raw_label))
}

draw_pheatmap_pdf <- function(mat, out_pdf, annotation_row = NULL, annotation_colors = NULL,
                              width = 8, height = 10, main = "", scale = "row",
                              show_rownames = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
                              cluster_rows = nrow(mat) > 1, fontsize_row = NULL) {
  if (is.null(mat) || nrow(mat) == 0 || ncol(mat) == 0) return(invisible(FALSE))
  if (is.null(fontsize_row)) fontsize_row <- if (nrow(mat) > 40) 6 else wgbs_figure_tick_size
  fontsize_row <- max(6, min(wgbs_figure_tick_size, fontsize_row))
  heatmap_plot <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat,
    scale = scale,
    show_rownames = show_rownames,
    cluster_cols = cluster_cols,
    cluster_rows = cluster_rows,
    annotation_row = annotation_row,
    annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
    color = viz_pal$heat_compare,
    main = "",
    fontsize_row = fontsize_row,
    fontsize = wgbs_figure_base_size,
    fontfamily = wgbs_figure_font_family,
    silent = TRUE
  )
  wgbs_draw_grid_dual(
    file = out_pdf, width = width, height = height,
    draw = {
      grid::grid.newpage()
      grid::grid.draw(heatmap_plot$gtable)
    }
  )
  invisible(TRUE)
}

standardize_chr_style <- function(chr, target_has_chr = FALSE) {
  chr <- as.character(chr)
  chr <- sub("^chr", "", chr, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (target_has_chr) paste0("chr", chr) else chr
}

mouse_main_chr_levels <- function(target_has_chr = FALSE) {
  standardize_chr_style(c(as.character(1:19), "X", "Y"), target_has_chr = target_has_chr)
}

quiet_gviz_deprecations <- function(expr) {
  withCallingHandlers(
    expr,
    warning = function(w) {
      warn_msg <- conditionMessage(w)
      if (grepl("S4Vectors:::anyMissing", warn_msg, fixed = TRUE) ||
          grepl("Use 'anyNA()' instead", warn_msg, fixed = TRUE)) {
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    }
  )
}

load_main_chr_cgi_context <- function(cgi_file, target_has_chr = FALSE) {
  if (!file.exists(cgi_file)) return(NULL)
  cgi_raw <- readr::read_tsv(cgi_file, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)
  gr_island <- GRanges(
    seqnames = standardize_chr_style(cgi_raw$X2, target_has_chr = target_has_chr),
    ranges = IRanges(start = cgi_raw$X3 + 1, end = cgi_raw$X4)
  )
  strand(gr_island) <- "*"
  gr_island <- gr_island[as.character(seqnames(gr_island)) %in% mouse_main_chr_levels(target_has_chr = target_has_chr)]
  if (length(gr_island) == 0) return(NULL)

  gr_n_shore <- flank(gr_island, width = 2000, start = TRUE)
  gr_s_shore <- flank(gr_island, width = 2000, start = FALSE)
  gr_n_shelf <- flank(gr_n_shore, width = 2000, start = TRUE)
  gr_s_shelf <- flank(gr_s_shore, width = 2000, start = FALSE)

  gr_all_cgi_context <- c(gr_n_shelf, gr_n_shore, gr_island, gr_s_shore, gr_s_shelf)
  mcols(gr_all_cgi_context)$context <- rep(
    c("N_Shelf", "N_Shore", "Island", "S_Shore", "S_Shelf"),
    times = c(length(gr_n_shelf), length(gr_n_shore), length(gr_island), length(gr_s_shore), length(gr_s_shelf))
  )
  gr_all_cgi_context
}

build_mean_bw_track <- function(bw_files, chr_use, view_start, view_end, track_name, fill_col) {
  bw_files <- bw_files[file.exists(bw_files)]
  if (length(bw_files) == 0) return(NULL)

  region_gr <- GRanges(chr_use, IRanges(view_start, view_end))
  region_len <- width(region_gr)

  score_list <- lapply(bw_files, function(bw_file) {
    rle_list <- tryCatch(
      rtracklayer::import(bw_file, which = region_gr, as = "RleList"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(rle_list) || !(chr_use %in% names(rle_list))) {
      return(rep(NA_real_, region_len))
    }
    signal_rle <- rle_list[[chr_use]][view_start:view_end]
    signal_vec <- as.numeric(signal_rle)
    if (length(signal_vec) != region_len) {
      signal_vec <- rep_len(signal_vec, region_len)
    }
    signal_vec
  })

  score_mat <- do.call(cbind, score_list)
  mean_score <- rowMeans(score_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!any(is.finite(mean_score))) return(NULL)
  mean_score[!is.finite(mean_score)] <- 0

  mean_rle <- Rle(mean_score)
  run_starts <- cumsum(c(1L, head(runLength(mean_rle), -1L)))
  run_ends <- cumsum(runLength(mean_rle))
  mean_gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = chr_use,
    ranges = IRanges(start = view_start + run_starts - 1L, end = view_start + run_ends - 1L),
    score = runValue(mean_rle)
  )

  quiet_gviz_deprecations(Gviz::DataTrack(
    range = mean_gr,
    data = mcols(mean_gr)$score,
    genome = "mm39",
    chromosome = chr_use,
    name = track_name,
    type = "histogram",
    fill = fill_col,
    col = fill_col,
    ylim = c(0, 1)
  ))
}

read_dmr <- function(file_path, dataset_name, config) {
  if(!file.exists(file_path)) stop("DMR输入不存在: ",file_path)
  df <- read_csv(file_path,show_col_types=FALSE)
  required <- c("DMR_id","seqnames","start","end","diffMethy","meanMethy_group1","meanMethy_group2","group1_label","group2_label")
  if(length(setdiff(required,names(df)))) stop(dataset_name," 缺少现役DMR字段: ",paste(setdiff(required,names(df)),collapse=","))
  group1 <- unique(as.character(df$group1_label));group2 <- unique(as.character(df$group2_label))
  if(length(group1)!=1L || length(group2)!=1L || anyNA(c(group1,group2)) ||
     !identical(group1,config$expected_reference_group) || !identical(group2,config$expected_comparison_group))
    stop(dataset_name," DMR分组标签必须唯一且严格等于配置reference/comparison")
  for(nm in c("gene_id_clean","SYMBOL","ENTREZID","annotation","annotation_simple")) if(!nm %in% names(df)) df[[nm]] <- NA_character_
  df <- df %>% mutate(input_row=row_number(),seqnames=standardize_chr_style(seqnames,target_has_chr=FALSE),
    start=as.integer(start),end=as.integer(end),meanMethy_WT=meanMethy_group1,meanMethy_PFOS=meanMethy_group2,
    diffMethy_raw=diffMethy,diffMethy_pfos_wt=meanMethy_PFOS-meanMethy_WT,
    annotation_simple=simplify_feature(dplyr::coalesce(annotation_simple,annotation)),
    passes_effect_contract=is.finite(diffMethy_pfos_wt)&abs(diffMethy_pfos_wt)>=config$min_abs_effect)
  if(anyNA(df[c("seqnames","start","end")]) || any(df$start<1L | df$end<df$start) || anyDuplicated(df[c("seqnames","start","end")])) stop(dataset_name," DMR坐标无效或重复")
  if(any(!is.finite(df$diffMethy_raw)) || any(!is.finite(df$diffMethy_pfos_wt)) || any(abs(df$diffMethy_raw-df$diffMethy_pfos_wt)>1e-7)) stop(dataset_name," 原始DMR效应与显式comparison-reference均值差不一致")
  n_input <- nrow(df);n_below <- sum(!df$passes_effect_contract)
  if(isTRUE(config$enforce_effect_contract)) df <- df %>% filter(passes_effect_contract)
  if(!nrow(df)) stop(dataset_name," 当前效果阈值下无DMR")
  attr(df,"group1_label") <- group1;attr(df,"group2_label") <- group2
  attr(df,"n_input") <- n_input;attr(df,"n_below_effect_contract") <- n_below
  df
}

run_enrichment <- function(entrez_ids, title_prefix, out_prefix) {
  source(file.path(integration_root,"scripts/joint_plot_helpers.R"),local=environment())
  j <- new.env(parent=globalenv());j$root<-integration_root;j$out<-cross_config$out_dir
  j$cfg<-integration_config;j$analysis<-paste0("wgbs_",basename(cross_root));j$rows<-list()
  source_bg <- function(ctx) {
    folder <- ctx
    p <- joint_cached(j,"measured_regions_coverage_eligibility")
    if(!file.exists(p)) stop("先运行当前rebuild_wgbs_rna.R生成直接覆盖背景: ",p)
    z <- readr::read_tsv(p,show_col_types=FALSE)
    unique(z$gene_id_clean[z$eligible])
  }
  universe <- intersect(source_bg(cross_config$source1_short),source_bg(cross_config$source2_short))
  ids <- intersect(unique(na.omit(as.character(entrez_ids))),AnnotationDbi::keys(org.Mm.eg.db,keytype="ENTREZID"))
  genes <- if(length(ids)) AnnotationDbi::select(org.Mm.eg.db,keys=ids,keytype="ENTREZID",columns="ENSEMBL")$ENSEMBL else character()
  sets <- joint_gene_sets(j)
  for(collection in c("GO_BP","KEGG")) {
    z <- joint_ora(genes,universe,sets[[collection]])
    write_csv(z,file.path(cross_config$out_dir,paste0("06_Table_",collection,"_",out_prefix,".csv")))
    top <- z %>% filter(Count>0,pvalue<integration_config$p_cutoff) %>% slice_head(n=15L)
    if(nrow(top)) {
      p <- ggplot(top,aes(FoldEnrichment,reorder(Description,FoldEnrichment),size=Count,color=-log10(pvalue)))+
        geom_point()+theme_wgbs_classic()+labs(title=paste(title_prefix,collection),subtitle="Exploratory raw P; BH retained; directly covered two-context universe",x="Fold enrichment",y=NULL)
      ggsave(file.path(cross_config$out_dir,paste0("06_Enrich_",collection,"_",out_prefix,".pdf")),p,width=9,height=7,device=cairo_pdf)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 2. 数据读取、方向统一与重叠 DMR 整理
# ==============================================================================
source1_df <- read_dmr(cross_config$source1_dmr_file, cross_config$source1_name, cross_config)
source2_df <- read_dmr(cross_config$source2_dmr_file, cross_config$source2_name, cross_config)

message("✅ 数据加载完成: ", cross_config$source1_name, " DMRs = ", nrow(source1_df),
        ", ", cross_config$source2_name, " DMRs = ", nrow(source2_df))

gr_source1 <- GRanges(source1_df$seqnames, IRanges(source1_df$start, source1_df$end))
gr_source2 <- GRanges(source2_df$seqnames, IRanges(source2_df$start, source2_df$end))
hits <- findOverlaps(gr_source1, gr_source2, minoverlap = 1)

if (length(hits) == 0) stop("❌ 两组 DMR 没有重叠，分析终止。")

merged_dmr <- tibble(
  source1_idx = queryHits(hits),
  source2_idx = subjectHits(hits)
) %>%
  mutate(
    source1_chr = source1_df$seqnames[source1_idx],
    source1_start = source1_df$start[source1_idx],
    source1_end = source1_df$end[source1_idx],
    source2_chr = source2_df$seqnames[source2_idx],
    source2_start = source2_df$start[source2_idx],
    source2_end = source2_df$end[source2_idx],
    source1_diff = source1_df$diffMethy_pfos_wt[source1_idx],
    source2_diff = source2_df$diffMethy_pfos_wt[source2_idx],
    source1_gene = source1_df$gene_id_clean[source1_idx],
    source2_gene = source2_df$gene_id_clean[source2_idx],
    source1_symbol = source1_df$SYMBOL[source1_idx],
    source2_symbol = source2_df$SYMBOL[source2_idx],
    source1_entrez = source1_df$ENTREZID[source1_idx],
    source2_entrez = source2_df$ENTREZID[source2_idx],
    source1_anno = source1_df$annotation[source1_idx],
    source2_anno = source2_df$annotation[source2_idx],
    source1_feature_simple = dplyr::coalesce(source1_df$annotation_simple[source1_idx], simplify_feature(source1_anno)),
    source2_feature_simple = dplyr::coalesce(source2_df$annotation_simple[source2_idx], simplify_feature(source2_anno)),
    source1_WT = source1_df$meanMethy_WT[source1_idx],
    source1_PFOS = source1_df$meanMethy_PFOS[source1_idx],
    source2_WT = source2_df$meanMethy_WT[source2_idx],
    source2_PFOS = source2_df$meanMethy_PFOS[source2_idx]
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    common_symbol = dplyr::coalesce(source1_symbol, source2_symbol, source1_gene, source2_gene),
    common_entrez = dplyr::coalesce(source1_entrez, source2_entrez),
    source1_state = ifelse(source1_diff >= 0, "Hyper", "Hypo"),
    source2_state = ifelse(source2_diff >= 0, "Hyper", "Hypo"),
    Category = case_when(
      source1_diff > 0 & source2_diff > 0 ~ "Common_Hyper",
      source1_diff < 0 & source2_diff < 0 ~ "Common_Hypo",
      TRUE ~ "Discordant"
    ),
    DirectionCombination = case_when(
      source1_diff > 0 & source2_diff > 0 ~ "Hyper / Hyper",
      source1_diff > 0 & source2_diff < 0 ~ "Hyper / Hypo",
      source1_diff < 0 & source2_diff > 0 ~ "Hypo / Hyper",
      TRUE ~ "Hypo / Hypo"
    ),
    source1_abs = abs(source1_diff),
    source2_abs = abs(source2_diff),
    Magnitude_Ratio = source2_abs / pmax(source1_abs, 1e-6),
    EffectState = case_when(
      Category == "Discordant" ~ "Opposite_direction",
      Magnitude_Ratio >= 1.25 ~ "Larger_in_source2",
      Magnitude_Ratio <= 0.75 ~ "Smaller_in_source2",
      TRUE ~ "Comparable"
    ),
    Feature_Simple = source1_feature_simple
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = factor(Category, levels = c("Common_Hyper", "Common_Hypo", "Discordant")),
    DirectionCombination = factor(DirectionCombination, levels = transition_levels),
    EffectState = factor(EffectState, levels = effect_state_levels),
    Feature_Simple = factor(Feature_Simple, levels = feature_levels)
  )

write_csv(merged_dmr, file.path(cross_config$out_dir, "01_overlap_details.csv"))
```

```{r}
common_dmr <- merged_dmr %>% filter(Category != "Discordant")

} else {
  NA_real_
}

p_scatter <- ggplot(merged_dmr, aes(x = source1_diff, y = source2_diff, color = Category)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = viz_pal$neutral["mid"]) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = viz_pal$neutral["mid"]) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = viz_pal$category, drop = FALSE) +
  theme_wgbs_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Signed Methylation Difference Concordance",
    x = paste0(cross_config$source1_name, " ΔMethylation (", integration_config$comparison, " - ", integration_config$reference, ")"),
    y = paste0(cross_config$source2_name, " ΔMethylation (", integration_config$comparison, " - ", integration_config$reference, ")")
  )

if (nrow(common_dmr) >= 2) {
  p_scatter <- p_scatter +
    geom_smooth(data = common_dmr, method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = viz_pal$neutral["dark"], fill = "#D6ECAE") +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = min(merged_dmr$source1_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
      y = max(merged_dmr$source2_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4.2,
      color = viz_pal$neutral["dark"],
      label = paste0("Common DMRs (n = ", nrow(common_dmr), ")\nDescriptive overlap-pair rho = ", round(cor_val_common, 3))
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 8. Common-direction 位点浏览图
# ==============================================================================
message("⏳ 绘制 common-direction locus 浏览图...")

has_locus_plot_pkgs <- requireNamespace("Gviz", quietly = TRUE) &&
  requireNamespace("rtracklayer", quietly = TRUE)

track_groups <- cross_config$track_groups
all_track_files <- unlist(lapply(track_groups, `[[`, "files"), use.names = FALSE)
missing_track_files <- all_track_files[!file.exists(all_track_files)]

if (!has_locus_plot_pkgs) {
  message("⚠️ 未检测到 Gviz/rtracklayer，跳过 common-direction locus 浏览图。")
} else if (length(missing_track_files) > 0) {
  message("⚠️ 缺少 BigWig 文件，跳过 common-direction locus 浏览图。")
  message("   缺失文件示例: ", paste(head(missing_track_files, 4), collapse = "; "))
} else {
  plot_has_chr <- any(grepl("^chr", merged_dmr$source1_chr))
  main_chr_levels <- mouse_main_chr_levels(target_has_chr = plot_has_chr)
  txdb <- AnnotationDbi::loadDb(cross_config$txdb_file)
  cgi_context_gr <- tryCatch(load_main_chr_cgi_context(cross_config$cgi_file, target_has_chr = plot_has_chr), error = function(e) NULL)

  common_loci <- merged_dmr %>%
    filter(Category != "Discordant") %>%
    mutate(
      locus_chr = standardize_chr_style(source1_chr, target_has_chr = plot_has_chr),
      locus_start = pmin(source1_start, source2_start, na.rm = TRUE),
      locus_end = pmax(source1_end, source2_end, na.rm = TRUE),
      locus_label = dplyr::coalesce(common_symbol, source1_gene, source2_gene),
      locus_label = ifelse(is.na(locus_label) | locus_label == "", paste0("CommonDMR_", row_number()), locus_label)
    ) %>%
    filter(locus_chr %in% main_chr_levels) %>%
    group_by(locus_label, Category, locus_chr) %>%
    summarise(
      chr = dplyr::first(locus_chr),
      start = min(locus_start, na.rm = TRUE),
      end = max(locus_end, na.rm = TRUE),
      feature = names(sort(table(Feature_Simple), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
      n_pairs = n(),
      combined_score = max(source1_abs + source2_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(start), is.finite(end), is.finite(combined_score)) %>%
    arrange(Category, desc(combined_score), chr, start)

  write_csv(common_loci, file.path(cross_config$out_dir, "08_Common_Direction_Loci.csv"))

  if (nrow(common_loci) > 0) {
    combined_pdf <- file.path(cross_config$out_dir, "08_Common_Direction_Loci.pdf")
    cairo_pdf(combined_pdf, width = 12, height = 8)

    old_ucsc_chromosome_names <- getOption("ucscChromosomeNames")
    options(ucscChromosomeNames = FALSE)

    tryCatch({
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(common_loci))) {
        locus_row <- common_loci[i, ]
        chr_use <- as.character(locus_row$chr)
        view_start <- max(1L, locus_row$start - 20000L)
        view_end <- locus_row$end + 20000L

        axis_track <- quiet_gviz_deprecations(Gviz::GenomeAxisTrack())
        common_window_df <- merged_dmr %>%
          mutate(
            locus_chr = standardize_chr_style(source1_chr, target_has_chr = plot_has_chr),
            locus_start = pmin(source1_start, source2_start, na.rm = TRUE),
            locus_end = pmax(source1_end, source2_end, na.rm = TRUE)
          ) %>%
          filter(
            Category != "Discordant",
            locus_chr == chr_use,
            locus_start <= view_end,
            locus_end >= view_start
          )

        dmr_track <- NULL
        if (nrow(common_window_df) > 0) {
          common_gr <- GRanges(
            seqnames = common_window_df$locus_chr,
            ranges = IRanges(common_window_df$locus_start, common_window_df$locus_end),
            Category = common_window_df$Category
          )
          dmr_track <- quiet_gviz_deprecations(Gviz::AnnotationTrack(
            range = common_gr,
            genome = "mm39",
            chromosome = chr_use,
            name = "Common DMR",
            fill = ifelse(mcols(common_gr)$Category == "Common_Hyper",
                          unname(viz_pal$category["Common_Hyper"]),
                          unname(viz_pal$category["Common_Hypo"])),
            col = NA,
            shape = "box"
          ))
        }

        cgi_track <- NULL
        if (!is.null(cgi_context_gr)) {
          cgi_window <- cgi_context_gr[
            as.character(seqnames(cgi_context_gr)) == chr_use &
              start(cgi_context_gr) <= view_end &
              end(cgi_context_gr) >= view_start
          ]
          if (length(cgi_window) > 0) {
            cgi_track <- quiet_gviz_deprecations(Gviz::AnnotationTrack(
              range = cgi_window,
              genome = "mm39",
              chromosome = chr_use,
              name = "CGI",
              fill = viz_pal$track_cgi,
              col = NA,
              shape = "box"
            ))
          }
        }

        gene_track <- NULL
        if (!is.null(txdb)) {
          gene_track <- tryCatch(
            quiet_gviz_deprecations(Gviz::GeneRegionTrack(
              txdb,
              genome = "mm39",
              chromosome = chr_use,
              start = view_start,
              end = view_end,
              name = locus_row$locus_label,
              transcriptAnnotation = "transcript",
              collapseTranscripts = "meta"
            )),
            error = function(e) NULL
          )
        }

        bw_tracks <- lapply(track_groups, function(track_group) {
          fill_col <- unname(viz_pal$group[track_group$group])
          build_mean_bw_track(track_group$files, chr_use, view_start, view_end, track_group$label, fill_col)
        })

        track_list <- c(list(axis_track), bw_tracks, list(dmr_track, cgi_track, gene_track))
        track_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), track_list)
        gviz_display_pars <- list(
          fontfamily = wgbs_figure_font_family,
          fontfamily.title = wgbs_figure_font_family,
          fontsize = wgbs_figure_tick_size,
          cex = 0.7,
          cex.axis = 0.7,
          cex.title = 0.55,
          fontface.title = 1,
          rotation.title = 90
        )
        track_list <- lapply(track_list, function(track) {
          Gviz::displayPars(track) <- gviz_display_pars
          track
        })

        if (length(track_list) > 1) {
          track_sizes <- c(0.45, rep(1, length(track_groups)), 0.55, 0.4, 0.95)
          quiet_gviz_deprecations(Gviz::plotTracks(
            trackList = track_list,
            from = view_start,
            to = view_end,
            chromosome = chr_use,
            sizes = track_sizes[seq_along(track_list)],
            background.title = "white",
            col.title = viz_pal$neutral_dark,
            cex.main = 0.8,
            fontface.main = 1,
            margin = 4,
            main = paste0(
              locus_row$locus_label, " | ", locus_row$Category,
              " | ", locus_row$feature,
              " (", chr_use, ":", view_start, "-", view_end, ")"
            )
          ))
        }
      }
    }, finally = {
      options(ucscChromosomeNames = old_ucsc_chromosome_names)
      dev.off()
    })
  } else {
    message("⚠️ 未找到可用于 locus 浏览图的 common-direction 位点。")
  }
}
```

```{r result_report, include=FALSE}
source(file.path(integration_root,"scripts/joint_plot_helpers.R"),local=environment())
j <- new.env(parent=globalenv());j$root<-integration_root;j$out<-cross_config$out_dir;j$cfg<-integration_config
j$analysis<-paste0("wgbs_",basename(cross_root));j$rows<-list()
write_csv(merged_dmr,file.path(cross_config$out_dir,"01_overlap_details.csv"))
write_csv(tibble(source=c(cross_config$source1_short,cross_config$source2_short),path=c(cross_config$source1_dmr_file,cross_config$source2_dmr_file),md5=unname(tools::md5sum(c(cross_config$source1_dmr_file,cross_config$source2_dmr_file)))),file.path(cross_config$out_dir,"00_Current_Input_Manifest.csv"))
pdfs <- list.files(cross_config$out_dir,pattern="\\.pdf$",full.names=TRUE)
for(pdf in pdfs) {
  id <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(pdf));png<-sub("\\.pdf$",".png",pdf)
  table <- if(grepl("Enrich",id)) {
    file.path(cross_config$out_dir,paste0(sub("Enrich","Table",id),".csv"))
  } else if(grepl("Loci",id)) file.path(cross_config$out_dir,"08_Common_Direction_Loci.csv") else file.path(cross_config$out_dir,"01_overlap_details.csv")
  if(!file.exists(png)||!file.exists(table)) stop("图与源表必须成套: ",id)
  joint_record(j,id,gsub("_"," ",id),table,png=png,pdf=pdf,
    meaning="比较两个情境中的坐标重叠、效应方向和直接测量的位点甲基化。",
    distribution=paste0("图内单位为DMR重叠pair，many-to-many可能重复区域；源表保留两端坐标和注释。",if(grepl("2cell",basename(cross_root)))"2cell仅高风险敏感性展示。" else ""),
    conclusion="同位点或同方向只是描述一致性，不证明甲基化传递、sperm介导或位点因果性。")
}
for(expected in c("06_Enrich_GO_BP_Hyper","06_Enrich_GO_BP_Hypo","06_Enrich_KEGG_Hyper","06_Enrich_KEGG_Hypo")) {
  if(!file.exists(file.path(cross_config$out_dir,paste0(expected,".pdf"))))
    joint_skip(j,expected,gsub("_"," ",expected),"直接覆盖背景下候选数不足或没有raw-P合格条目；不沿用旧无背景富集","EMPTY")
}
joint_finish(j)
```
